conclusion: The reproduced broad-run failure was the unchanged result-exists assertion after its 60-second wait, while the lock remained and the journal was at target-committed.
Unconditional finally cleanup could interfere with the detached transaction and replace the original failure with EBUSY.

Single-file diagnostic runs passed on both commits; the current broad run failed and later completed. These observations do not establish a native-helper product regression or a specific host-performance cause.
Late success does not change a failed test to passed. The timeout remains unresolved.
